title: Balassi Bálint összes verse: hálózati kritikai kiadás (network critical edition of the complete poems)
author: Bálint Balassi
institution: Eötvös Loránd University, Budapest (edited by Iván Horváth and Tünde Tóth; published by Gépeskönyv)
notes: Critical edition of Balassi's poems, first published online in 1998 (version 1.0), revised as 1.1 (1999) and 2.0 (2002), with facsimiles, apparatus, notes and a repertory. The site is a set of HTML frames. Counts are ours: about 110 poem pages and 21,800 words in the critical-text frame of the 116 pages linked from the contents list, leaving out line numbers, notes and apparatus; figures are approximate. Newest file seen was modified in 2006.
